title: CPF Module Schema: Relay Service
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-relaynamespace'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

create_wcf_rules.description: (Optional) To create wcf rules or not.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

namespace_authorization.type: map(object({ name = string listen = optional(bool, false) send = optional(bool, false) manage = optional(bool, false) }))
namespace_authorization.description: (Optional) map(object({ name = (Required) The name which should be used for this Azure Relay Namespace Authorization Rule. Changing this forces a new Azure Relay Namespace Authorization Rule to be created. listen = (Optional) Grants listen access to this Authorization Rule. Defaults to false. send = (Optional) Grants send access to this Authorization Rule. Defaults to false. manage = (Optional) Grants manage access to this Authorization Rule. When this property is true - both listen and send must be set to true too. Defaults to false. For namespace auth rule to be created, any one of the three must be set to true. }))

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

sku_name.description: (Required) The name of the SKU to use. At this time the only supported value is Standard.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

wcf_authorization_rules.type: map(object({ relay_name = string name = string rights = list(string) }))
wcf_authorization_rules.description: (Optional) map(object({ relay_name = (Required) The name of the WCF Relay. name = (Required) The authorization rule name. rights = (Required) String array containing any of: "Listen", "Manage", "Send". Providing manage rights requires both listen and send to be selected. }))

wcf_relay.type: map(object({ name = string relayType = string userMetadata = optional(string) }))
wcf_relay.description: (Required) map(object({ name = (Required) The name of the WCF Relay. relayType = (Required) The value of the WCF relay type should either be "Http" or "NetTcp". userMetadata = (Optional) The usermetadata is a placeholder to store user-defined string data for the WCF Relay endpoint. For example, it can be used to store descriptive data, such as list of teams and their contact information. Also, user-defined configuration settings can be stored. }))

id.description: The ID of the created relay namespace.

name.description: The Name of the relay namespace.

namespace_authorization_id.description: The ID of the relay namespace authorization rule.

namespace_authorization_name.description: The Name of the relay namespace authorization rule.

namespace_authorization_resource.description: The Resource of the created relay namespace authorization rule.

resource.description: The Resource of the created relay namespace.

wcf_authorization_resource.description: The Resource of the created wcf authorization rule.

wcf_authorization_rule_name.description: The Name of the wcf authorization rule.

wcf_relay_name.description: The Name of the wcf relay.

wcf_resource.description: The Resource of the created wcf relay.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Relaynamespace' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
